meta.note: Skill roster source of truth. tools/skills.js --write regenerates the roster tables in skill-pool*.md; --checks runs the mechanic gate (checks.md D18). Edit here, never hand-edit between the GENERATED markers.

type_meta.buff: Cleared for redesign · tree nodes still reference the old 14
type_meta.curse: Attached to target · Uses same hit_chance as attacks

reservation.note: The player opens auras; the only system rule is that total reserved mana may not reach 100% of the pool — some mana must stay usable for skills. There is no other cap.

formula.note: skill_damage = (stat × K_STAT × stat%/100 + power × power%/100) × K_SKILL × (1 + skill_level × level_step_pct/100). Read by tools/lib/skillmodel.js for the --calc workshop and the attack-table eff-cd / presses-per-sec columns.

skills.name: Cleave
skills.effect: Swing around, hits all in range

skills.name: Elemental Break
skills.effect: Heavy hit + target takes +15% Element damage 8 sec (replaces Guard Break, which referenced a nonexistent system)

skills.name: Whirlwind
skills.effect: Spin 3 rounds, 1 hit per target per round · Per-target hit count = proc engine

skills.name: Shield Bash
skills.effect: Stops target attacks 1 sec (uses no chance, so does not hit the 15% stun Cap)

skills.name: Puncture
skills.effect: Applies 3 poison stacks (melee that feeds DoT)

skills.name: Riposte
skills.effect: Damage +3% per 1% player dodge chance (Cap +120%) · Gives dodge builds a boss path

skills.name: Execute
skills.effect: x2 if target HP below 20%

skills.name: Retribution
skills.effect: Damage grows with lost HP (maximum x2 at 50% HP) · Tank tool on bosses

skills.name: Piercing Shot
skills.effect: Single target · This hit does not roll dodge

skills.name: Volley
skills.effect: Arrow spread hits all in range

skills.name: Arrow Shower
skills.effect: 3 arrows, 40% each, 120% total of formula · Per-hit procs fire 3 times

skills.name: Headshot
skills.effect: This hit +25% crit chance · Burst window for crit builds

skills.name: Arcane Bolt
skills.effect: Uses weapon Element · Hits at all ranges

skills.name: Flame Lash
skills.effect: Fire · Applies full 3 burn stacks in one press (fills the missing fire-skill slot)

skills.name: Chain Spark
skills.effect: Lightning · Shocks all hit

skills.name: Frost Nova
skills.effect: Cold around self · Chills all

skills.name: Toxic Spray
skills.effect: 2 poison stacks to all in range

skills.name: Void Lance
skills.effect: Chaos · Pierces 100% of target Elemental res on this hit (answer to res-required zones)

skills.name: Weaken
skills.effect: Target deals -25% damage

skills.name: Blinding Mark
skills.effect: Target accuracy -30% (multiplies with our dodge = true EHP)

skills.name: Sunder
skills.effect: Target Elemental res -20% · Opens res-blocked zones

skills.name: Expose
skills.effect: Target takes +20% damage

skills.name: Cripple
skills.effect: Target aspd -20% · Element-free so usable with all weapons

skills.name: Jinx
skills.effect: Target easier to crit: our crit chance against it +15%

skills.name: Mark of the Executioner
skills.effect: Target Execute threshold shifts from 20% to 35% · Finisher skills/keystones trigger more often

skills.name: Venom Bind

skills.name: Shatter

skills.name: Pandemonium
skills.effect: Curse spreads to neighbors when the afflicted target dies (3-target Cap per AoE rules)

skills.name: Heal

skills.name: Greater Heal
skills.effect: Restores 20% Max HP instantly · Covers last-moment windows

skills.name: Cleanse
skills.effect: Cleanses all statuses on self + restores 8% Max HP · Answer to 10-stack poison

skills.name: Wraith of Fury
skills.effect: aspd +12%

skills.name: Clarity

skills.name: Vitality
skills.effect: hp regen +30%
